title: Neighborhood home
caption: The desktop landing page introduces Old Town, community activity, navigation, and the Ask for help action.

title: Neighborhood feed
caption: The feed combines posts, comments, votes, category tabs, search, group filters, and task-status filters.

title: Giveaway and volunteer offer cards
caption: Giveaways and free-help offers appear beside ordinary neighborhood information.

title: Find help page
caption: The volunteering discovery page brings free help requests and volunteer offers together.

title: My tasks page
caption: A member’s requests, applications, and assignments appear in the task board.

title: Login page
caption: The simulated login page includes email/password fields, recovery, registration, and a demo shortcut.

title: Invalid login
caption: An incorrect demo password displays an inline error.

title: Account recovery form
caption: A neighbor can enter an email address for simulated account recovery.

title: Recovery confirmation
caption: The confirmation explicitly states that delivery is simulated; no email is sent.

title: Registration page
caption: Registration collects name, email, password, neighborhood, private address, and agreement to community rules.

title: Completed registration form
caption: Fictional address information is submitted privately for membership review.

title: Registered account pending approval
caption: New accounts enter a pending state, and publishing controls are disabled.

title: Successful simulated login
caption: Valid demo credentials restore access to the approved neighbor’s community.

title: Membership page
caption: Membership status, self-declared residency, neighborhood selection, and private address submission are visible here.

title: Membership request form filled
caption: The address is restricted to membership review and is not displayed on the public feed.

title: Membership review pending
caption: Submitting a membership request returns the member to a pending state.

title: Moderator membership review
caption: A local moderator can review the privately submitted address and approve or reject membership.

title: Membership approved
caption: Approval restores neighborhood publishing controls.

title: Outside neighborhood restriction
caption: A member viewing another neighborhood cannot publish there or read that neighborhood’s member feed.

title: Pending member restriction
caption: The seeded pending neighbor Sam Rivera sees the pending notice and disabled publishing actions.

title: Rejected membership
caption: A rejected member remains unable to publish and sees the rejected status.

title: Help requests filter
caption: Selecting Help requests narrows the feed to that post type.

title: Offers to help filter
caption: Selecting Offers to help narrows the feed to that post type.

title: Giveaways filter
caption: Selecting Giveaways narrows the feed to that post type.

title: Events filter
caption: Selecting Events narrows the feed to that post type.

title: PSAs filter
caption: Selecting PSAs narrows the feed to that post type.

title: Garage sales filter
caption: Selecting Garage sales narrows the feed to that post type.

title: Text search results
caption: Text search matches post titles and descriptions.

title: Empty search results
caption: An empty-results message offers a clear way to recover by changing search or filters.

title: Category filter
caption: Category filtering narrows posts to a service area such as Tech help.

title: Group filter
caption: A group filter narrows the neighborhood feed to Garden Club posts.

title: Task status filter
caption: The task-status filter exposes the current request state.

title: A few good books, free to a new home details
caption: The detail view opens the full post, author, category, approximate location, reactions, and conversation.

title: A friendly hand with your tech details
caption: The detail view opens the full post, author, category, approximate location, reactions, and conversation.

title: Let’s grow something together details
caption: The detail view opens the full post, author, category, approximate location, reactions, and conversation.

title: A heads-up from the neighborhood details
caption: The detail view opens the full post, author, category, approximate location, reactions, and conversation.

title: Saturday porch treasure hunt details
caption: The detail view opens the full post, author, category, approximate location, reactions, and conversation.

title: Help request form upper section
caption: Required fields are title, description, category, and approximate location.

title: Help request optional fields
caption: Optional controls include date/time, volunteer count, group sharing, neighborhood visibility, and a photo.

title: Public address validation
caption: An exact street address is rejected in public post fields; a general area should be used.

title: Published help request
caption: The new request appears immediately in the browser-local neighborhood feed.

title: Edit post form
caption: Authors can edit title, description, category, location, schedule, capacity, group, sharing, and photo.

title: Saved post changes
caption: The revised title and volunteer capacity are reflected in the detail view.

title: Post deleted
caption: Deleting an authored post removes it from the neighborhood feed.

title: Free volunteer offer form
caption: The same composer supports offers of free assistance, with category and availability details.

title: Published volunteer offer
caption: The volunteer offer opens as a complete neighborhood post.

title: Photo attachment preview
caption: The composer accepts an optional image and displays a preview before publishing.

title: Published PSA with attachment
caption: The published post retains its optional attachment.

title: Help request details open
caption: The requester sees post actions, help status, applications, task history, and neighborhood comments.

title: Upvote applied
caption: The selected upvote and net vote total change together.

title: Vote changed to downvote
caption: Changing vote direction replaces the prior vote rather than creating an additional vote.

title: Vote removed
caption: Selecting the same vote again removes it and restores the net total.

title: Appreciation reaction
caption: A separate heart reaction records appreciation without completing the task.

title: Comment posted
caption: A neighborly comment appears with the author’s name in the public conversation.

title: Address rejected in comment
caption: The public conversation rejects exact street-address text; private chat is the appropriate place for it.

title: Report post form
caption: A report describes the concern and explains that penalties require moderator review.

title: Report submitted
caption: A report is recorded without automatically changing the author’s reputation.

title: Blocked author hidden from feed
caption: Blocking a neighbor removes that author’s posts from the viewer’s feed.

title: Blocked-neighbor settings
caption: Settings list blocked neighbors and provide an Unblock control.

title: Neighbor unblocked
caption: The blocked entry is removed and the neighbor can appear in the feed again.

title: Eligible volunteer receives alert
caption: A new help request creates a simulated alert for an available volunteer with matching preferences.

title: Volunteer request before application
caption: The eligible volunteer sees the application action; task chat is not available yet.

title: Volunteer application sent
caption: Applying does not assign the volunteer; approval is still required.

title: Application withdrawn
caption: A volunteer can withdraw before approval.

title: Requester reviews two applicants
caption: The requester can compare applicants’ task counts and points, then approve or decline them.

title: First volunteer assigned
caption: Approving a volunteer changes the task to Assigned and opens a private task chat.

title: Multiple volunteers approved
caption: The task records both participants and capacity; approval remains requester-controlled.

title: Three-person task chat
caption: The requester and two approved volunteers share a private task conversation.

title: Task message sent
caption: Chat content is visible to the requester and approved task participants.

title: Unassigned member has no task chat
caption: An unrelated approved neighbor can view the public post but does not receive the private task conversation.

title: Task in progress
caption: An approved participant starts work, moving the task to In progress.

title: Awaiting requester confirmation
caption: The volunteer requests confirmation; the task is not completed or rewarded yet.

title: Requester completion confirmation
caption: The requester receives the Confirm completion action.

title: Task completed and rewarded once
caption: Completion is confirmed and each approved volunteer receives one ten-point task reward.

title: Task experience feedback
caption: Either task party can report an experience for moderator review; reports do not impose automatic penalties.

title: Leaderboard after completion
caption: The leaderboard reflects the confirmed task points for both approved volunteers.

title: Completed task board filter
caption: The task board can be narrowed to completed work.

title: Task chat listed in Messages
caption: Approved task conversations also appear in the member’s conversation list.

title: Application declined
caption: The requester can decline an application without assigning the volunteer or opening chat.

title: Task cancelled
caption: Cancelling changes the state while retaining the assignment history.

title: Request reopened with retained history
caption: Reopening restores Open status, clears active assignments, and retains prior approvals and cancellation history.

title: Fallback unavailable before 72 hours
caption: The fallback closure control is disabled until the confirmation waiting period has elapsed.

title: Fallback enabled after demo clock advance
caption: The explicit demo clock simulates the proposed 72-hour waiting period.

title: Fallback task closure
caption: The task closes with a recorded fallback history entry and one-time completion points.

title: Fallback queued for review
caption: Fallback closure produces a moderator-review report rather than silently bypassing oversight.

title: Groups page
caption: Approved local circles list their purpose, sample member count, join/leave action, and group page.

title: Group page as member
caption: A joined group shows posts, a mute option, and a group-post composer action.

title: Group muted from circle page
caption: Group members can silence matching alerts directly from the circle.

title: Group-specific composer
caption: Opening the composer from a circle preselects the group.

title: Group-only sharing setting
caption: Unchecking neighborhood sharing keeps a group post restricted to the circle.

title: Group left
caption: After leaving, the group offers Join group and matching group alerts no longer target the member.

title: Group joined
caption: Joining a new circle changes its action to Joined / Leave.

title: Propose group dialog
caption: A new circle requires a name and description and waits for moderator approval.

title: Duplicate group detected
caption: A duplicate group name is rejected without creating another circle.

title: Group proposal pending
caption: The proposed group is listed as pending and is not yet available for joining.

title: Group proposal in moderator queue
caption: A local moderator reviews proposed groups within the neighborhood.

title: Approved group available
caption: An approved group becomes visible with its submitted description and a Join group control.

title: Messages landing page
caption: The conversation list includes message requests and approved task chats; no conversation is selected initially.

title: Incoming private-message request
caption: The recipient must accept or decline before either side can exchange private messages.

title: Message request declined
caption: Declining removes the request without creating a conversation.

title: New message-request recipient
caption: The sender chooses an approved neighbor from the same neighborhood.

title: Outgoing request awaiting consent
caption: The sender sees a waiting state; no message input appears before acceptance.

title: Recipient reviews message request
caption: The recipient can accept the new request or decline it.

title: Accepted private conversation
caption: Acceptance opens the private message input.

title: Private message delivered in simulation
caption: The message is added to the accepted conversation in local browser data.

title: Private conversation viewed by other participant
caption: The other accepted participant sees the same simulated message.

title: Private conversation hidden from unrelated neighbor
caption: An unrelated account does not see or access another pair’s private conversation.

title: Alerts page with new item
caption: Website alerts show read state and simulated delivery channels.

title: Alerts marked read
caption: Mark all as read clears the visible unread state.

title: Empty alerts state
caption: A member with no matching website alerts sees a quiet-state message.

title: Notification settings
caption: A neighbor controls website, email, simulated browser delivery, categories, group muting, and blocked neighbors.

title: Delivery channels changed
caption: The demo stores channel preferences; browser delivery remains explicitly simulated.

title: Category subscription changed
caption: A deselected category no longer qualifies the member for matching request alerts.

title: Group alert mute enabled
caption: A muted group is excluded from matching request delivery.

title: Preferences persist after reload
caption: Saved browser-local settings survive a page reload.

title: Member profile
caption: The profile presents the neighbor, membership status, bio, availability, points, task count, and badges.

title: Profile editor
caption: The member can change the display name and biography.

title: Profile edits saved
caption: The updated biography appears on the profile.

title: Volunteering paused
caption: Pausing availability removes the member from eligible volunteer alert targeting and prevents new applications.

title: Volunteering resumed
caption: Availability can be restored without changing neighborhood membership.

title: Neighborhood leaderboard
caption: The leaderboard ranks approved neighbors using sample points and confirmed work.

title: Badges and scoring rules
caption: Recognition explains net vote points, ten-point task rewards, point/task/category badge thresholds, and reviewed penalties.

title: Moderator dashboard
caption: Local moderators review reports, membership, and group proposals.

title: Report review dialog
caption: Every moderation decision includes an action, recorded reason, and optional justified point adjustment.

title: Resolved report decision
caption: The resolved report retains the recorded decision reason.

title: Suspension review action
caption: Suspension requires an explicit moderator decision and reason.

title: Suspended-member restriction
caption: The suspended account sees its membership state and loses publishing controls.

title: Escalation prepared
caption: A moderator may send an unresolved case to nonprofit staff with a recorded reason.

title: Staff escalations dashboard
caption: Staff can review the escalated report and proposed neighborhoods.

title: Content removal and reviewed penalty
caption: Staff can remove a reported post and record a justified reputation adjustment.

title: Staff decision retained in history
caption: The resolved escalated report remains visible with its reason.

title: Reported content removed
caption: The removed PSA is absent from the neighborhood feed.

title: Propose neighborhood dialog
caption: A neighbor can propose a missing neighborhood for nonprofit staff review.

title: Duplicate neighborhood warning
caption: Known or already-proposed neighborhood names are rejected.

title: Neighborhood proposal pending
caption: A submitted neighborhood is listed as waiting for staff review.

title: Neighborhood staff review queue
caption: Staff review the new neighborhood proposal separately from local group approvals.

title: Neighborhood proposal approved
caption: Staff approval creates an available neighborhood listing.

title: Approved neighborhood still needs membership
caption: Creating a neighborhood does not grant posting permission; the member must still request membership.

title: Desktop layout at 1366 by 768
caption: The desktop layout keeps the main navigation, community dashboard, and primary action visible.

title: Narrow layout at 390 pixels
caption: The narrow layout reorganizes the same frontend without horizontal page overflow.

title: Narrow navigation drawer
caption: A compact menu exposes the same app sections.

title: Narrow groups layout
caption: Local circle cards stack vertically on a narrow display.

title: Demo reset and role toolbar
caption: Reset demo restores sample data; the toolbar switches between requester, volunteers, pending neighbor, moderator, and staff.
